newsitems.title: PUBG Global Championship 2026 Heads to İstanbul, Türkiye!
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents:
[p]The most prestige stage of the year, the PUBG Global Championship 2026 (PGC 2026), runs from December 1 (Tue) to December 13 (Sun) in İstanbul, Türkiye.[/p][p align="start"]
[/p][p align="start"]Thirty-two teams from around the world will compete across nine match days for a $1,500,000+ prize pool and the title of PUBG Esports global champion. Fan-driven crowdfunding will add to the prize pool, with additional rewards going to the top-performing teams.[/p][p align="start"]
[/p][h1][b]PGC 2026 Overview[/b][/h1][p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/Od3eKaLo.png"][/img][/b][/p][list][*][p]Location: İstanbul, Türkiye[/p][/*][*][p]Dates: December 1 (Tue) – December 13 (Sun), 2026[/p][/*][*][p]Teams: 32[/p][/*][*][p]Prize Pool: $1,500,000 (+ crowdfunding)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]A New Qualification Path[/b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/CIwQcuLd.png"][/img][/h2][p align="start"]For PGC 2026, each team's starting stage is determined by their results across PGS and regional leagues throughout the season. Unlike previous seasons where all teams began from a shared Group Stage, top-seeded teams will skip earlier stages and enter the tournament at a later point.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/4SqeIax6.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/FtbEQkUf.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]There are three entry paths to PGC 2026:[/p][list][*][p]Grand Finals Direct Invite — 8 teams[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage Day 1 Direct — 8 teams[/p][/*][*][p]Qualifying Stage Entry — 16 teams[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]This tiered structure rewards teams that performed well throughout the season with a stronger starting position at PGC, and raises the stakes for every match across the regional leagues and PGS leading up to the global stage.[/p][p align="start"]Note: If a team qualifies for PGC through both PGS points and a regional league, the higher-stage qualification takes precedence. When both qualifications correspond to the same stage, PGS points take priority. Any seed that goes unused due to double qualification is removed and reallocated to the next-in-line team in that region's PGC points standings.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Regional Seed Allocation[/b][/p][list][*][p]Global Seeds (PGS) — 8 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Americas (PAS) — 4 slots[/p][/*][*][p]China (PCL) — 4 slots[/p][/*][*][p]EMEA (PEC) — 4 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Korea (PWS) — 3 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Rest of APAC (PMS) — 2 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Thailand (PTS) — 3 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Vietnam (PVS) — 3 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Wildcard — 1 slot[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]The Wildcard slot will go to a team representing Türkiye, the host region for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]Tournament Format[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The tournament consists of three phases: [b]Qualifying Stage, Survival Stage[/b], and [b]Grand Finals.[/b][/p][p align="start"][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/mMT0z8lu.png"][/img][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Qualifying Stage — December 1 (Tue)[/b][/p][p align="start"]The 16 Qualifying Stage seeds compete on the opening day.[/p][p align="start"]The top 8 advance to Survival Stage Day 1, while the remaining 8 move to Survival Stage Day 2.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Survival Stage — December 2 (Wed) – December 6 (Sun)[/b][/p][p align="start"]The Survival Stage runs across five days, with 16 teams competing each day.[/p][p align="start"]From Day 1 through Day 4, the team with the highest combined match score on each day secures a direct ticket to the Grand Finals — one per day, four teams in total.[/p][p align="start"]On the final day, the top 16 teams by cumulative points across Days 1 through 4 compete for the last four Grand Finals spots.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Grand Finals — December 11 (Fri) – December 13 (Sun)[/b][/p][p align="start"]The Grand Finals span three days with a total of 15 matches (five per day). The final standings and the year's global champion will be decided here.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Grand Finals Qualified Teams[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The 16 teams competing at the Grand Finals reach the stage through three paths.[/p][p align="start"][b]Grand Finals Direct Invite — 8 teams[/b][/p][list][*][p]Six Regional League 1st place teams + PGS 1st place + Host Country Wildcard[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Survival Stage Daily Match Winners — 4 teams[/b][/p][list][*][p]One match winner from each of Survival Stage Day 1 through Day 4[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Survival Stage Cumulative Top 4 — 4 teams[/b][/p][list][*][p]Top 4 by total points across the entire Survival Stage[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]Prize Pool[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The total PGC 2026 prize pool is $1,500,000+, made up of the Ranking Prize (based on final standings) and the Special Prize (awarded for key performances during the Grand Finals).[/p][p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260518/J6crpHtc.png"][/img][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Ranking Prize — $1,310,000 total[/b][/p][p align="start"]The Ranking Prize is distributed to all participating teams based on Grand Finals qualification and final standings. Minimum guaranteed payouts for teams that do not reach the Grand Finals are integrated into the same Ranking Prize structure, creating a single, unified payout system.[/p][p align="start"][b]Special Prize — $190,000 total[/b][/p][p align="start"]Additional prizes are awarded for key performances during the Grand Finals.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Crowdfunding[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Fan-driven crowdfunding returns for PGC 2026. This season brings one notable change: crowdfunding contributions will be distributed exclusively to the Grand Finals Top 8 teams, allocated by final standing (30% to 4%).[/p][p align="start"]The more fans take part, the larger the final prize pool grows, and the greater the rewards for top-performing clubs. Details on how to participate will follow through official channels.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Closing[/b][/p][p align="start"]With this season's PGS and regional league results directly shaping each team's starting point at PGC 2026, every remaining match carries added weight. Stay tuned for the 32 teams set to compete for the title this December in İstanbul.[/p][p align="start"]Further details on PGC 2026 will follow through PUBG Esports' official channels.[/p]

newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
If Valve isn't going to bring us Left 4 Dead 3 any time soon, we'll just have to get our zombie game fix elsewhere, and Mann Versus Zombies is looking like just what I need. This total-conversion mod for Team Fortress 2 transforms the multiplayer shooter into a gradually escalating horde survival experience akin to Call of Duty Zombies. Built by a team of modders that has dubbed itself Breadworks, it brings the timeless roster of characters and locations into a fresh spin on a tried-and-tested format.

newsitems.title: Beloved Dota 2 esports team Heroic has just disbanded, saying it's a "tough game to commercialize"
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
Dota 2 esports is in an odd place. Once the premier sphere, it's been overtaken by the mammoth that is League of Legends - a beast that isn't showing any signs of slowing down. While Dota 2 remains huge in the East, its Western appeal has started to falter over the years, partly because it doesn't quite have the same content release cadence as other MOBAs, and partly because there's that big shiny thing called 'Deadlock' in the works. We've seen the legendary OG rip out its roster and start all over again, The International 2025's prize pool capped out at a mere $2,881,791 (for context, in 2021 it was $40,018,195), and now, Heroic has confirmed that it's leaving Dota 2 behind.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: Beloved Dota 2 esports team Heroic has just disbanded, saying it's a "tough game to commercialize"

The International is getting closer. After many years, Dota's ultimate proving ground is returning to China and returning to August, which is now just a few short months away.

In preparation, we've updated the registration process for any teams interested in participating in The International this year.

All interested teams must sign up through the [url=https://www.dota2.com/proregistration/home/]Dota pro team registration site[/url]. A manager must first register their team, and then each of the players must join individually. As part of team registration, a team representative must agree with the team participation agreement for this year's event. This agreement requires that teams and players abide by certain rules, including treating their players fairly and equally, and can be viewed during the registration process, as well as [url=https://www.dota2.com/registrationguidelines]here[/url].

Teams must complete the registration process by [b]2pm PDT on Monday, May 18th[/b] to be eligible for a direct invitation to The International or any Regional Qualifier.

We'll be back later this month with more details, including team invitations, qualifier details, and information on ticket sales. The final push to reach Dota's biggest stage is about to begin.

[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4406e5732fa1f2ac5c3a422bcf3bc6fc13aab5f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Raise the Stakes[/h3][p] [/p][p]The ongoing battle between JSOC and The Guild heats up as the balance of power shifts. With guidance from Karma, expert infiltrator Cole “Javelin” Donovan has successfully hacked into The Guild’s system using his C-Link device, allowing JSOC to turn The Guild’s own defenses against them. Will they use this newfound advantage to push toward victory and tear apart the oppressive conglomerate? Or will their enemies regroup in time for the counterattack?[/p][p] [/p][p]Season 03 Reloaded fans the flames with a firestorm of new content across all modes, including new experiences like Heat Wave Havoc and Hot Pursuit joined by extra maps, game modes, the next Round-Based Zombies Map, and additional Weapons, Blueprints, Operator Skins and more earned across Mid-Season Events and Weekly Challenges. [/p][p][/p][p]Gear up and engage the enemy when the Mid-Season update arrives in [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™ [/i]on Thursday, April 30 at 9AM PT.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Season 03 Reloaded Endgame[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][/p][h2]ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Endgame Free to Play Update: [/b]Endgame remains free to play for a limited time, offering new and returning players the chance to drop into the co-operative PvE experience focused on squad-based runs, boss, encounters, and repeatable challenges.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Operation Broken Mirror:[/b] Operations deepen with the introduction of Act II: Operation Broken Mirror, introducing new challenges, rewards, and the Virus Injection Glitch. Complete the Operation with Vermaak, Zaveri, or Jurado to earn a new Weapon Camo, and with all three to access a new Animated Weapon Camo.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Major Ability:[/b] Set enemies aflame with the new Thermal Spike Major Ability, punishing foes caught in the path of fire.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Endgame Remains Free to Play[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/89dbd2f571c3669e55ee3840371b3bf68b14f54e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Endgame will remain available as a free-to-play game mode for a limited time. Access the mode from the main [i]Call of Duty[/i] menu and within [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] and [i]Black Ops 7[/i]. Recruit new players to face the challenges within Avalon in this co-operative PvE mode where squads encounter increasingly difficult combat zones while taking on bosses and repeatable challenges while evolving their Operator along the way.[/p][p] [/p][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2025/11/call-of-duty-black-ops-7-co-op-campaign-endgame"]Learn more about Endgame here.[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Act II: Operation Broken Mirror[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][i]Our insider has established a link. Infiltrate the Guild network and gather enough Diagnostic Data to develop a virus that can destroy the network.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Act II is about breaking the system, not just learning it.[/p][p] [/p][p]With JSOC now linked to Javelin following Operation Poison Pill, the team confirms The Guild’s attempt to stand up a mirror C‑Link network. Karma’s objective is clear: build a virus powerful enough to shut it down... but doing so requires first mapping the network’s true structure.[/p][p][/p][p]Players return to Avalon to gather Diagnostic Data through targeted operations that disrupt Guild assets and expose the mirror network’s inner workings. These missions escalate toward the discovery of a Glitch Fracture, allowing players to breach the network’s corrupted core. By exploiting that breach, JSOC gains a delivery path for Karma’s virus, putting Javelin in position to deploy it from within and collapse the mirror network entirely.[/p][p] [/p][p]Earn new rewards for every completed objective, including powerful upgrades for your Operator that will aid them in future steps.[/p][p] [/p][p]In the final step, gain access to the new Virus Injection Glitch and take on the Glitch Boss. Operation rewards include a new Weapon Blueprint, Emblem, Double XP Token, Restore Token, Loading Screen, and more, detailed below.[/p][p] [/p][p]Note that while Operation Poison Pill started with objectives that needed to be completed in Zone I or higher, Operation Broken Mirror begins with a Zone III or higher requirement right from Step 1, so ensure your Operator is up to the task before starting this Operation![/p][p][/p][h3]Face the Virus Injection Glitch, Earn Rewards[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f7060a9b152e60d582ccc3765b902ebaad0c493.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Earn a variety of valuable rewards and get powered up as you progress through the steps. Discover the location of the Virus Injection Glitch and take on waves of enemies and the Glitch Boss in Nightmare Difficulty.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeat the Virus Injection Glitch Boss in the final step of Operation Broken Mirror with Vermaak, Zaveri, or Jurado to earn the unique “Aftershock” Operator Skin.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Act II Skin Completion Camos:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 “Aftershock” Operator Skin to get the “Braincase” Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][*][p]Earn all 3 “Aftershock” Operator Skins to get the “Neon Gallows” Animated Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Operation Broken Mirror Rewards[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/95d2bf067e195849a682f2a22ee348279c538585.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]·  “Adrenal Drive” Weapon Charm and 1,000 XP[/p][p]·  Restore Token and 1,000 XP[/p][p]·  1 Hour Double Player XP Token and 1,000 XP[/p][p]·  “Meltdown” Emblem and 2,500 XP[/p][p]·  1 Hour Double Battle Pass XP Token and 2,500 XP[/p][p]·  “Toxic Drip” Large Decal and 2,500 XP[/p][p]·  1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token and 5,000 XP[/p][p]·  “Hype Dose” Loading Screen and 5,000 XP[/p][p]·  “Tiny Hello” Emote and 5,000 XP[/p][p]·  “Lethal Injection” Weapon Blueprint, “Virus Injection” Animated Calling Card, and 7,500 XP[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]New Activity: Mega Abomination[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4ac2a2f32a087f6829066b4e4ecea392e7a10603.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Face a new boss that spawns in Nightmare Zones once the Guild Strike boss for the zone has been conquered! Defeating the Mega Abomination guarantees an Exotic Weapon Case drop, so the encounter should be well worth your time... if you survive.[/p][p] [/p][h3]New Major Ability: Thermal Spike[/h3][p][i]Emit a powerful blast of flames that incinerate enemies. Flames persist in the area for a short duration.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p]Heat up your future deployments with the new Thermal Spike Major Ability. Set fire to your foes and finish them off before the flames expire.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Season 03 Reloaded Multiplayer[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][/p][h2]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps: [/b]Don’t get too relaxed in the Onsen hot springs map designed for 6v6 and 2v2 matches; the spa’s laid-back design is a ruse for the heated combat ahead. Plus, cool off with the Remastered Summit and revisit Hacienda.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Freerun:[/b] Put your movement skills to the ultimate test as The Guild recruits volunteers for a new training program. For a cooler experience, play a game of Freeze Tag where it’s your team’s goal to chill the enemy while keeping your allies in the fight.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p] [/p][p][b]Onsen[/b][/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/687a4133a039cde3179d471a7886d62f7c681495.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Assault a remote onsen in Yamanashi as a clandestine deal falls apart and fighting erupts. Pass by the oni statue on your way into the hot springs, the rising steam obscuring visuals across. Take the plunge or climb up the opposite building into the war room featuring a powerful balcony vantage point and access to the outer cliffside. Relax along the pool, terrace, and sauna, or cut enemy foes off at the underpass.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/01e2422671b8ca7db7795b7207d30f918ed91df2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Summit[/b][/p][p][i]Remastered, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7acc09e2c35f4ecb1ab8c6bd2bb7d3b3f51b2f29.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The iconic Summit returns as players breach a dangerous Russian facility perched atop a snow-covered mountain. This classic mid-sized map was first introduced in the original [i]Black Ops[/i], its three-lane layout funneling Operators into hot zones like the central control room and across the narrow cliffside and catwalk.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f5e5f8f07cedd7e7ad5282ed6507ea049fe5a788.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This remastered version offers the most detailed incarnation of Summit to date, with Wall Jumping adding a new twist to the many battles head.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Hacienda[/b][/p][p][i]Returning, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d3dad7611d27930f68fd33d4cc40d19e0aee8d9d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Attack a fortified crime family estate as rival forces storm the mansion grounds in Hacienda, a classic mid-sized map centered in and around the grand villa. Gawk at the luxury vehicles in the driveway on your way to the foyer opening onto the estate. Enjoy the art and engage in long fights down the Gallery or stretch your legs out in the vineyard. For a more relaxed experience, stroll through the garden and take a dip in the pond.[/p][p] [/p][p]First seen in 2018, Hacienda fits right into [i]Black Ops 7[/i], bringing both new and classic environments to the Mid-Season map pool.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Freerun[/b][/p][p][i]New Mode, Launch[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/62f249150098e7f43ec09b9007556b5dd28ed001.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Guild is seeking early volunteers for a new Project Synapse training program, providing contestants the opportunity to prove themselves as you race against the clock while overcoming obstacles.[/p][p] [/p][p]Overseen by Dr. Atwood, the Freerun course takes place on the Ascent map, a Guild Tower construct designed specifically for the Freerun mode. When the race begins, follow the track to progress through an increasingly demanding 10 zones, testing your abilities across a variety of challenges. Pull off difficult Wall Jumps, slide under low walls, hop across spinning platforms, and, as the course ramps up, use a variety of weapons to hit targets, opening the path forward.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/295b6909bc63cad7099a682096ff00c1c90bc937.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Later zones will further challenge you with the addition of the Grappling Hook and Wingsuit, ensuring that contestants are tested on every facet of combat maneuvers. With ten racers per match, you’ll need to keep up your momentum to pull ahead.[/p][p] [/p][p]Freerun Course Rewards:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2d7d767c783cf50c9bc5278c0922dbe240799e7c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Complete the Freerun: Ascent course three times to earn the “Scaled” Emblem and 1,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Collect all Ciphers in Freerun: Ascent to earn the “Upswing” Weapon Charm and 2,500 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Complete the Freerun: Ascent course in under 14 minutes with fewer than 10 faults to earn the “Innovate” Universal Weapon Camo and 5,000 XP.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Compete for additional rewards in the Mid-Season Freerun: Ascent Challenge Event—including two additional Weapon Camos—detailed in the Season 03 Reloaded Events section found below in the General Content section of this blog.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Heat Wave Havoc[/b][/p][p][i]New Mode, In-Season[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/11936b622f7b296348e68d9c43a7c70d180fde71.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Get fired up in Heat Wave Havoc, a new LTM that rewards Operators with enhanced abilities for supporting their team with non-lethal cooperative actions. Drop into a Mosh Pit of Team Deathmatch, Kill Confirmed, Domination, and Hardpoint, and see how hot you can get to become a firestorm of destruction.[/p][p] [/p][p]Operators progress through five different Heat Levels, each level granting additional abilities improving combat efficiency. Generate heat through support actions like revealing enemies, scrambling enemy radars, buffing teammates, impairing enemies, capturing and defending objectives, and other non-lethal actions.[/p][p] [/p][p]Support your team to generate heat and gain Operator bonuses based on your Heat Level as follows:[/p][p] [/p][p]·   [b]Low Heat:[/b] Faster Field Upgrade recharge.[/p][p]·   [b]Medium Heat:[/b] Faster movement, sprint-to-fire speed, and mid-air mobility.[/p][p]·   [b]Hot:[/b] Faster weapon reloads, ADS speed, and swap speed.[/p][p]·   [b]Extra Hot:[/b] Equipment refills after eliminating enemies.[/p][p]·   [b]Extra Extra Hot:[/b] Increased damage and score for headshots.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Freeze Tag[/b][/p][p][i]New Mode, In-Season

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c478e30612864311f26223d3eb58672cc622a07e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Cool off with a game of Freeze Tag, a new 6v6 respawn mode where teams compete to freeze their enemies while keeping allies thawed and in the fight. Eliminated Operators drop into a frozen state, where they are unable to complete any actions until a teammate shatters them free by shooting or otherwise damaging their downed teammate.[/p][p] [/p][p]If one team manages to freeze the entire enemy team, a Total Freeze will occur, releasing all Operators from their frozen status and awarding the team who froze all enemies a large score boost. Use your mini-map to track the location of frozen teammates, so you can prevent a Total Freeze from being inflicted on your side. The first team to reach the score limit wins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Black Ops 7: Season 03 Reloaded Zombies[/b][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p align="center"][b]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Round-Based Zombies Map — Totenreich: [/b]The crew descends on an old Norwegian fishing village, first founded during the Bronze Age and now caught in the Dark Aether. Welcome to Totenreich, the new Round-Based Zombies map arriving with Season 03 Reloaded. Explore the unsettling relationship between the locals and the Group 935 research facility established there, investigating nefarious experiments in the wake of giants.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Enemies and Wonder Weapon:[/b] Face the dreaded Necropincer, rising from the depths to attack the unwary with its deadly trident and a ferocious mutated claw. Also wield the Jotunn Star, a wide-sweeping melee Wonder Weapon that bathes and burns enemies with spectral energy.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Features: [/b]Roast zombies to a crisp with the Flammenfalle Trap, bringing much needed heat to this cold island. Still not hot enough? Try out the new Wild Fire Field Upgrade to pulse waves of fire that burns enemies who get too close. Take on the Main Quest for XP and rewards, test your skills in Cursed, unlock new Pack-a-Punch Camos, and perhaps find a fabled Ultra-Rarity Legacy Weapon within the Mystery Box![/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Map: Totenreich[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a6c766ffd3fa0641a3c2a971dbd1bcada9e0e11f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]“Welcome to Eidskallen – Sorry about the reception committee.”[/i] — The Twins[/p][p] [/p][p]The time loop is broken, and following the Dark Heart’s defeat in Paradox Junction, the Twins transport the crew to a new destination: Eidskallen, a Norse fishing village on a blustery, windswept coast that has been inhabited since the late Bronze Age. Historians have noted that the site has been occupied through the centuries, all the way to the age of Vikings, and into modern times. Indeed, evidence of medieval Norse structures can be found across the island, from burial mounds, a feasting hall, and a strange stave church. All overlooked by an ominous lighthouse, still shining its light into the gloom.[/p][p] [/p][p]The entire settlement has been ripped from reality, casting the Group 935 research base and their hulking mechanical machinations into the Dark Aether.[/p][p] [/p][p][i]“… this place… is mein legacy.”[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Deploy to the frozen birthplace of nuclear fire and explore the ancient village that Group 935 transformed into a research base hiding sinister secrets.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Totenreich: Giants Collide[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/78ff0ac9e86318d6e0e9b641157a880a507f3475.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As a towering Shadowsmith threatens to crush them underfoot, the crew barely escapes. The gigantic creature is bound to this place, and you must explore the island to get to the bottom of its dark past.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f817ea231d58bca335433406a78770e423ae4361.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Uncover rickety pathways and use ziplines to cross frozen, icy waters as you navigate the island.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Totenreich: New Enemy: Necropincer[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fbc973efa537c4389c7dd692a2e902768220a116.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Tales tell of a doomed undead Viking warrior spirit—known to some as a Draugr— challenging invaders to vicious armed combat. It seems the presence and the sheer brutality of Group 935 have awakened an unnatural aberration that rises from the cold seas to aid in the protection of Eidskallen. Said to be summoned by those “followers of the old ways,” these frightening chimeras now attack on sight, perhaps driven mad after further experimentation by Group 935 itself.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d40ad72027a8e4c1e2f27161933a48d06bada6d0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Necropincer wields a trident, piercing and stabbing adversaries who venture too close, while throwing the weapon at more distant foes. With its giant crab claw in place of a left arm, the creature can also block incoming shots and use this pincer to slam and bludgeon. This is an enemy equally prepared for offense and defense. A relentless combatant, the Necropincer exemplifies the cold death awaiting those unable to stand up against its formidable aggression.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Totenreich: New Wonder Weapon: Jotunn Star[/b][/p][p][i]Mastery Badges Available for this Weapon[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bf6909223af142b1e13c100969e51500f1e136c9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Forged when Odin ruled the sky and giants walked the land, this ancient lantern casts death-dealing fireballs and strikes down foes with a barbed iron chain. Are you worthy to wield it?[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]This wide-sweeping Melee Wonder Weapon can take on even the most cold-hearted of enemies, stealing their souls for use in generating devastating attacks. A Norse artifact fortunately hidden from Group 935’s covetous hands by those on the island familiar with its myths and “old ways,” the Jotunn Star casts light and deadly fire.[/p][p] [/p][p]With the Jotunn Star in hand, the wielder can attack enemies to inflict major damage. Striking them with up to five attacks in a row unleashes a deadlier hit, releasing an area of spectral energy on impact.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/13d7e4659fde3881c11c87fca5878e55bc270296.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Lantern Swing:[/b] A dexterous wielder can swing the weapon in front of them, using the blunt instrument to drop advancing undead.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Flame Charge:[/b] The Jotunn Star drains the essence of creatures it eliminates, storing the energy within the weapon. This energy can be stored to provide warmth and to enable the Flame Tendril and Flame Strike attacks.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Flame Tendril:[/b] When two or more fully charged lanterns are being utilized, a fiery cord connects them and slowly drains the life of anything that gets in its way[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Flame Strike: [/b]When sufficiently charged, the stored energy within the Jotunn Star can be discharged as a concentrated, explosive fireball, damaging and setting foes alight.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Totenreich: Flammenfalle Trap[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1e0a7a8767e8c4b1959775fb08813be87d2d82be.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Roast foes with a blast of flames.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Drop some Essence to spin up this new trap that shoots out three jets of flame incinerating undead foes in range of the hot blasts. Once you’ve got the power back up and running, this scorching trap is just the ticket if you want to heat up your slaying capabilities.[/p][p] [/p][p]Enhance the Flammenfalle’s abilities by activating a valve on the body of the trap, activating a heat zone that protects the crew from chilling effects, gives weapons the chance to trigger Napalm Burst, and passively builds the Jotunn Star’s Flame Charge while inside of the heat zone.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Totenreich: A Chill in the Air[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/84a64a79b4b7dcd659b0be0936dd41f92cfd10de.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Totenreich: New Main Quest, Quest Rewards, and Challenges[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b51d7ce710a642ade9ae5ce1c0d6826d4314c849.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Main Quest for Totenreich becomes available when the map releases with Season 03 Reloaded on April 30 at 9:00 AM PT. Complete the Main Quest to earn the following:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]The “Ambition” Richtofen Operator Skin, Calling Card, and 10,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Complete Totenreich Mastery Challenge for another Calling Card and 5,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Obtain the necessary Intel (Audio Logs, Documents, and Artifacts) to earn a third Calling Card and another 10,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Players who complete the Main Quest before Directed Mode arrives for this map will also earn a unique Calling Card variant.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Totenreich: Cursed Mode, New Pack-a-Punch Camos[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/af4955ef97e697fde6df70279a562f7caeb8138c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Take on the ultimate challenge with Cursed mode on Totenreich, offering no Main Quest guidance and providing a limited HUD and a starting Pistol. Hunt down new Cursed Relics and earn rewards including the following:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]The “Jade Legion” Pack-a-Punch Camo, Calling Card, and 15,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Crimson Legion” Pack-a-Punch Camo, Calling Card, and 20,000 XP.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Heliotrope” Pack-a-Punch Camo, Calling Card, and 25,000 XP.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New Field Upgrade: Wild Fire[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f679201f715d215001b435600687e15a70ca742.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Imbue yourself with fire, increasing your speed and burning all enemies that get too close.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]When the swarm is on you, or you need to push through the thick of it, Wild Fire may keep you safe. Activating this Field Upgrade radiates pulses of heat from your location that also engulfs enemies near the wielder, while you enjoy a small increase in speed. Wild Fire becomes even more powerful with its Augments, capable of incinerating anything that stands in your way.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9e20fbaf216199c5fc602ca5e07b52f8a7b67825.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Major Augments[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Fireball! [/b]While Wild Fire is active, fire balls will launch along with your attacks.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Firestorm: [/b]On activation, deploy a fire tornado that pulls in and immolates enemies.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Free Radical: [/b]While Wild Fire is active, the effects of the attack occasionally drop pools of fire on the ground.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Flashover: [/b]Starting with the initial activation, every third Wild Fire pulse deals significantly more damage in a larger radius.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Minor Augments[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Oxidizer: [/b]Increase Wild Fire’s duration.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Backdraft: [/b]On activation, nearby zombies are knocked down, and larger enemies are stunned.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Molten Core: [/b]Enemies are dealt more damage the closer they get to you.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Heat Surge: [/b]While Wild Fire is active, your movement speed is increased even further.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Call of Duty: Warzone Season 03 Reloaded Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][/p][h2]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/h2][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Limited-Time Modes:[/b] Engage in a high-speed chase of Police vs. Thieves in Hot Pursuit, a new limited-time mode testing your driving skills throughout Avalon. In Prop Hunt Royale, the party mode arrives as 24v24 on Rebirth Island, featuring over a dozen prop types to help players blend in with the environment.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Power Up with Spikes: [/b]Check your local Buy Station for the introduction of Spikes, an experimental military stimulant granting Operators improved combat capabilities including Armor Salvaging, Prone Firing, and Handicraft.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Lethal Addition:[/b] The Cluster Grenade arrives in the Mid-Season across Core Battle Royale and Resurgence modes, the ideal weapon for scattering and blasting enemy squads.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]New Limited-Time Modes[/h3][p] [/p][p][b]Hot Pursuit[/b][/p][p][i]Avalon, 100 players, Black Ops Royale[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ec203bedc1e43d83f87ee4f5ec0f4690b4a21db5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Drop into a high intensity squad mode where Police hunt down Thieves in a fast-paced, vehicle-driven game mode that will test your driving skills and see just how well you really know the streets of Avalon. To keep the action moving, Hot Pursuit features an increased vehicle spawn rate across the map, and with Resurgence rules in place, Operators will respawn up to a certain point as long as one squad member remains alive.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Police[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Police vehicles include the ATV, JLTV, and the Light Heli. Activate the sirens on these vehicles to initiate a radar pulse, showing nearby Thieves on the mini-map. In the Light Heli, this ability expands to include directional information on enemy movement.[/p][p] [/p][p]All Police vehicles also have the ability to see enemy vehicles through walls, so keep up the pressure and don’t let those robbers get away.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Thieves[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0ce2cc7f3d497ce7893cb84b8ceae6615742d384.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thieves get access to the UTV and Dirt Bike, preferring speed and mobility to zip through Avalon and leave the Police in the dust. With the UTV, players can activate a boost for increased speed, while the Dirt Bike allows players to trigger Active Camo and drop a Smoke Grenade. Both vehicles also have a passive ability guiding Thieves toward special loot caches with high quality items inside.[/p][p] [/p][p]The last squad standing wins.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Prop Hunt Royale[/b][/p][p][i]Rebirth Island, 48 players[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Prepare to join in on the fun of Prop Hunt in a large-scale setting as the party mode deploys to Rebirth Island. In this 24v24 round-based mode, teams alternate between the role of Hunters and Props.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/da343bb4d1c7e3c40c6556db84fdbed06e725c60.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Props[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Props get half a minute at the start of the round to select a prop and hide. From loot caches to office chairs, Buy Stations, barrels, and over a dozen other options, Props will test the Hunters’ ability to detect the real from the fake.[/p][p] [/p][p]Props can change up to three times and provide a limited number of Decoys and Stun Grenades to keep the Hunters at bay. Props can move but cannot swim underwater and will also emit a whistle effect at certain points throughout the match to keep the pressure up. If at least one prop remains at the end of the round, the Props win that round.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Hunters[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]It’s the Hunters’ job to seek out the Props and eliminate them, so evaluate your environment carefully. Was that item always there?[/p][p] [/p][p]Hunters can additionally seek out ground loot and loot caches for access to weapons and other gear including Stun Grenades and Grappling Hooks. Lethals and Field Upgrades are disabled. If Hunters eliminate all Props during a round, they win that round. [/p][p] [/p][p]The first team to win three rounds wins the match![/p][p][/p][h3]New Equipment: Spikes[/h3][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a551547cd93679f418e9ebfb8ecd6ecd3fda516c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You need every advantage you can get when competing in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], and Spikes are the latest means of getting ahead of your foes. Once the Mid-Season launches, deploy and head to a Buy Station to purchase the experimental military stimulant, including the following options:[/p][p] [/p][p]·  [b]Armor Salvaging: [/b]Immediately gain an equipped Armor Plate after eliminating an enemy.[/p][p]·  [b]Prone Firing: [/b]Greatly reduce weapon recoil while crouched or prone.[/p][p]·  [b]Handicraft: [/b]Regenerate Equipment over time.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Fallen Operators will need to repurchase Spikes, so keep up the pressure and don’t let the enemy get the first shot.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Lethal Addition: Cluster Grenade[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Devastate enemy squads as the Cluster Grenade expands from Black Ops Royale into Core Battle Royale and Resurgence modes across [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. With this deadly munition in hand, they won’t stand a chance.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: General Content (CM, MP, ZM, WZ)[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][/p][h2]Call of Duty: General Content Summary (All Modes and Games)[/h2][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Weapons, Attachments:[/b] Electrify your opponents with the new Siren Special Weapon or close the distance and dispatch them with the Katana Melee Weapon. Plus, enhance your weapons with new Attachments including the MK.78 Lightframe PDW Conversion, Warden 308 Badlands Pistol Kit, Carbon 57 Fabricator Mag, and the Ryden 45K Apex Sweeper Rig.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Events: [/b]Acquire new Mid-Season weapons, Attachments, and more across multiple Events, including a special RoboCop Event Pass featuring the new RoboCop Operator plus other free and premium rewards inspired by the legendary film franchise.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Store Offerings: [/b]Access new Ultra, Reactive, and Mastercraft Skins across new Bundles arriving in the Store throughout the Mid-Season, including the Tracer Pack: Luxury Crews Ultra Skin Bundle featuring Terry Crews as The Replacer.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Weapons Detail[/h3][p] [/p][p]Special Weapon: Siren (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Special, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cf885c878df2166b10f3f3ca2ea67cfcb77985e5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Levels: 30[/b][/p][p][b]MAGS: 3[/b][/p][p][b]MAG SIZE: 6[/b][/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][b]Attachments: [/b]Magazine, Rear Grip[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Blueprints, Camo Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Charge energy weapon. Fires a high-damage, slow-moving projectile that passes through foes. Charge to improve projectile velocity.[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Inflict high damage on enemies with this Special Weapon that fires a slow-moving projectile, its velocity increasing as you charge the weapon before letting loose on your target.[/p][p] [/p][p]The weapon’s effective damage range extends far out, allowing you to pummel foes up close or from a distance, though timing is crucial as the weapons rechambers between shots. In addition to the weapon’s powerful Prestige Attachment detailed below, the weapon also includes two Rear Grip options, one focused on improved mobility and the other on improved handling.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][i]Prestige Attachment[/i][/b][/p][p][i]Magazine > MFS Deflection Core[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f09ed4acd5b18f21e8a0a6fd72dfadfee535c749.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Fires a faster moving projectile that will ricochet off surfaces and enemies. Includes more ammo.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][b]Camos Confirmed: Weapon Prestige > Siren[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bea4be2c7a697052c67afacd039cb0f71090b01d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Universal Weapon Prestige Camos for the Siren (above): Prestige 1: “Racer.” Prestige 2: “Dionaea.” Prestige Max: “It’s Corn.”[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Melee Weapon: Katana (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Melee, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/63c04f9cc29b130c07a2e96eb99bda6880be7220.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Levels: 30[/b][/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][b]Attachments: [/b]None[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Blueprints[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Melee weapon. High damage, moderate range, and moderate attack speed.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Attack enemies up close with a combination of slashes and overhead attacks. Press the heavy attack button to hold the weapon up high, releasing at the perfect moment to inflict maximum damage.  [/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][b]Camos Confirmed: Weapon Prestige > Katana[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/63f1b9d05aa710ec31e0dd37173fad68537eb96e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Universal Weapon Prestige Camos for the Katana (above): Prestige 1: “Splash.” Prestige 2: “Sour Raspberry.” Prestige Max: “Enamored.”[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]New: Weapon Attachments[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8ebca6de3dd27686e216f9a5b5f06f9a45165586.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]MK.78 Lightframe PDW Conversion[/p][p][i]MK.78 LMG, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][i]Attachment > Stock[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d35f5a3a4bc1e0929049cb30fabf7c1bae8af255.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]A drastic weight reduction allows for more mobile and aggressive usage while retaining much of its power at the expense of additional recoil and reduced damage range.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Warden 308 Badlands Pistol Kit[/b][/p][p][i]Warden 308 Marksman Rifle, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][i]Attachment > Comb[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dfb0054527c29c5f6c38392736430df3dce393f1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][i]Heavy pistol configuration that sacrifices some control and range for improved handling and mobility with strong firepower at close range. Supports akimbo and three additional Barrel Attachments.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p]The Barrel Attachments unlocked when using the Warden 308 Badlands Pistol Kit include the following:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]10” Spiral Barrel: [/b][i]Extended barrel for improved damage range and recoil control.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]6” Snub Nose Barrel: [/b][i]Lightweight barrel for improved handling. Removes the pre-fire delay for a faster fire rate but harms damage range.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][b]8” Admonish Barrel: [/b][i]Extends one-hit kill potential to neck and upper torso at max range. Increases headshot multiplier to allow one-shot eliminations at longer range. Harms handling and recoil control.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Carbon 57 Fabricator Mag[/b][/p][p][i]Carbon 57 SMG, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][i]Attachment > Magazine[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6022d4147f3c35dc6d323b27722bd9a8e75ba3c3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]State of the art magazine that automatically replenishes its own ammo by fabricating additional rounds as soon as you stop firing.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Ryden 45K Apex Sweeper Rig[/b][/p][p][i]Ryden 45K SMG, Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][i]Attachment > Fire Mod[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/017f1d07c7dd2d315ced471e35f86e573ccd02d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Rounds that break apart in flight dealing damage with each piece that connects. Converts the weapon to semi-auto.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h3]Season 03 Reloaded Events[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9db16367d01bda17ad83a96d9133475be65023b7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Earn XP and rewards including new Season 03 Reloaded content like the Siren Special Weapon and Katana Melee Weapon plus new Weapon Camos, Weapon Charms, Operator Skins, Calling Cards, and more.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Event: RoboCop Event Pass (CM, MP, ZM, WZ)[/b][/p][p][i]Rewards Include: RoboCop New Operator, Siren Special Weapon[/i][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c24891d4ee0dd41db53751f5a05bd4fb994380be.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Part man. Part machine. All Operator. RoboCop doles out justice with the RoboCop Event Pass arriving in Season 03’s Mid-Season. Unlock limited-time rewards by earning XP in any mode. Serve the public trust with the new Siren Special Weapon plus additional Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, and more items inspired by the RoboCop film franchise.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/41ec02e91d610ba03bde2fb7c5174744562e45a9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Free Track[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Across all modes, acquire the following rewards for reaching XP milestones:[/p][p][/p][p]·  “Greasy Punk” Operator Skin[/p][p]·  “At Your Service” Spray[/p][p]·  “There Will Be Trouble” Calling Card[/p][p]·  “20 Second Compliance” Sticker[/p][p]·  “Drop It!” Loading Screen[/p][p]·  “OCP” Emblem[/p][p]·  “Your Move, Creep” Large Decal[/p][p]·  “Defiant Thug” Operator Skin[/p][p]·  “ED-209” Weapon Charm[/p][p]·  New “Siren” Special Weapon[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Get More with the Premium Reward Track[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/378e09b8624cc7074e0bb43fbde8333ff7c67de4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Purchase the Premium Track to progress along a second track of rewards featuring the following Premium Rewards earned alongside the Free Track:[/p][p] [/p][p]·  New “RoboCop” Operator[/p][p]·  “Defuser” MXR-17 Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint[/p][p]·  “TJ Lazer Twirl” Emote[/p][p]·  “OCP Firearm” Velox 5.7 Pistol Weapon Blueprint[/p][p]·  “Battleworn RoboCop” Operator Skin[/p][p]·  “Data Spiked” Finishing Move[/p][p]·  “RoboCop Vision” HUD Theme[/p][p]·  “Justice Server” Ryden 45K SMG Weapon Blueprint[/p][p]·  “Robo Pacesetter” Gunscreen[/p][p]·  “Pristine RoboCop” Operator Skin[/p][p] [/p][p]
[b]Event: Freerun Ascent Challenge (MP)[/b][/p][p][i]Rewards Include: Weapon Camos[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2c102e882c643fcfb2eb5c1fe7f70e44f258fde9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Can you make it to the top? Scale the Guild training tower as fast as you can in the new Multiplayer Freerun game mode and reach new heights on the Leaderboard to earn the following rewards:[/p][p] [/p][p]·  “Cyberize” Weapon Camo[/p][p]·  “Networked” Weapon Camo[/p][p]·  “Dodge!” Calling Card[/p][p]·  “Keep Running” Calling Card[/p][p]·  “Gain Foothold” Loading Screen[/p][p]·  “Sprinter” Weapon Charm[/p][p]·  “Wild Run” Kogot-7 SMG Weapon Blueprint[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Event: Call of Duty Endowment C.O.D.E. Navigator Challenge (CM, MP, ZM, WZ)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/30914cacd26f4dba630d7eb5f5bfe4603309dadf.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In honor of Military Appreciation Month, the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) introduces the C.O.D.E. Navigator Challenge Event to help veterans navigate their next chapter. Drop in for limited-time event rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Event: Multiplayer Ranked Series (MP) (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Rewards Include: Emblems, Weapon Camos[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/657da415c4bfed91ef5fddfd09249864207cd935.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Ranked Series Event is back for another chance to earn must-own rewards in the final week of the season! [/p][p] [/p][p]Win Ranked Play matches to climb a 50-player ladder against competitors within your same rank, from Gold Rank up to the Top 250 Rank. Get top placements to earn Season 03 Emblems and Weapon Camos, including a new Weapon Charm awarded for winning 10 Ranked Play matches.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Event: Call of Duty: Warzone Ranked Series (WZ) (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Rewards Include: Emblems, Weapon Camos[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cdd33b96393e2ab79c54758423f1ac4173568f7b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Compete in the second season of the [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]Ranked Play Event, featuring 50-player leaderboards with Emblem and Weapon Camo rewards for top placements across all Ranks. Secure Ranked Play wins to earn additional rewards including a new Weapon Charm and Large Decal.[/p][p] [/p][p]These Event Camos are distinct from the Multiplayer Ranked Event Camos and are earned in addition to the Weapon Camos unlocked during normal Ranked Play.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h3]New Store Offerings[/h3][p] [/p][p]Check the in-game Store throughout the Mid-Season for new Bundles offering a collection of Ultra Skins, Reactive Skins, and Mastercraft Skins, including the following highlights:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tracer Pack: Luxury Crews Ultra Skin Bundle[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c704da69bf7dab41afd7ff991a9c2029521033f4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Get in the seat, player. Terry Crews arrives as The Replacer in Season 03’s Mid-Season. Dress to flex in a killer suit and tie and power through the competition with three stylish Weapon Blueprints, a Finishing Move, and more items proving that this Operator has it handled. The Bundle features a new Ultra Operator Skin and the following:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/df731dc9358d8513eb9124f7666b90bbd3224c53.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]·  “Terry Crews” New Ultra Operator Skin (The Guild)[/p][p]·  “Acceleration” DS20 Mirage Assault Rifle Blueprint (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][p]·  “Swerve” RK-9 SMG Blueprint (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][p]·  “Stopper” Echo 12 Shotgun Blueprint (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][p]·  “Side Step Bustle” Finishing Move[/p][p]·  “Got Some Sway” Emote[/p][p]·  “Trusty Remote” Weapon Charm[/p][p]·  “Pecs Respect” Animated Calling Card[/p][p]·  “Trained Tough” Animated Emblem[/p][p]·  “Flex Yourself” Loading Screen[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tracer Pack: Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Navigator Bundle[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd6b882a0b6741c91e8e80f3d212626cabd41311.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Dare to explore with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Navigator Tracer Pack, featuring two Operator Skins inspired by and created in close collaboration with U.S. Navy SEAL and NASA astronaut, CAPT Chris Cassidy, (USN, ret.). This pack honors his military career journey from sea to space.[/p][p] [/p][p]Launching on Monday, May 4, purchase the Bundle to support the Endowment’s mission of helping U.S. and U.K. veterans find meaningful employment[/p][p] [/p][p]In partnership with the Call of Duty Endowment, USAA will offer a free Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Navigator: Tracer Pack [i]Call of Duty[/i]®: [i]Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Warzone[/i]™ to U.S. military service members and veterans.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Tracer Pack: Peace Protector Mastercraft Ultra Skin Bundle[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/86087aa9abd32c78c5b131321cf19a3e7d5fa0c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Fear not, for your safety is guaranteed with the “Civil Protector” Ultra Operator Skin for T.E.D.D., featuring three interchangeable heads that are sure to send criminals running. Protect society by any means necessary with this Bundle featuring a Mastercraft Weapon Blueprint, a Wonder Weapon Skin, and other items setting the standard for what it means to be a protector of the peace, including:[/p][p] [/p][p]·  “Civil Protector” Ultra Operator Skin for T.E.D.D. (including three interchangeable head options)[/p][p]·  “Stern Patroller” AK-27 Assault Rifle Blueprint (Mastercraft, Tracers, Death FX)[/p][p]·  “Morg’s Finest” SG-12 Shotgun Blueprint (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][p]·  “Fiery Guidance” Jotunn Star Wonder Weapon Blueprint[/p][p]·  “Teddtriloquist” Emote[/p][p]·  “Star of the Show” Reticle[/p][p]·  “Hound’s Badge” Animated Emblem[/p][p]·  “Duty Bound” Loading Screen[/p][p]·  “Peeling Alright” Weapon Sticker[/p][p]·  “Hidden Power” GobbleGum (x1)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Tracer Pack: Cyberfall Ultra Skin Bundle[/b][/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8e843843278000292cc603d9065d0af4127d7a0e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Disrupt the enemy team with this Bundle featuring the “Alibi Generator” Ultra Operator Skin for Anderson, featuring a digital mask that cycles through various appearances, obscuring the Operator’s true identity. Get three state of the art Weapon Blueprints, including one for the new Siren Special Weapon. Purchase this Bundle to access the following items:[/p][p] [/p][p]·  “Alibi Generator” Ultra Operator Skin for Anderson[/p][p]·  “Scan to Shoot” MXR-17 Assault Rifle Blueprint (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][p]·  “Identity Shot” VS Recon Sniper Rifle Blueprint (Tracers, Death FX)[/p][p]·  “Recognition Hamper” Siren Special Blueprint (New Weapon, Tracers, Death FX)[/p][p]·  “Facial Unrecognition” Emote[/p][p]·  “Cranial Dimension” Weapon Charm[/p][p]·  “Mug Identification” Animated Emblem[/p][p]·  “Changed Expression” Loading Screen[/p][p]·  “Contact List” Large Decal[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Tracer Pack: Transfusion Reactive Ultra Skin Bundle[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5bb519560d39a6f7d90328753dc319595f519c10.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Prolong your lifespan with the blood of your enemies with this deadly Bundle featuring two Ultra Skins, including a Reactive Ultra Skin for the Carbon 57 SMG that grows bloodier throughout the match. Plus, slice enemies to ribbons with a new Finishing Move, celebrate your victories with a new Emote, and other blood-fueled items including:[/p][p] [/p][p]·  “Coagulant” Ultra Operator Skin for newsitems.contents: [p]This Week in Destiny, we have a new Community Challenge ready for you straight from the desk of Vanguard Commander Zavala. Nothing too fancy: put on some amazing weapons, defeat enemies of humanity, get something great as reward.  [/p][p]Topics of the week: [/p][list][*][p]A new communal Community Challenge [/p][/*][*][p]It Binds, Compels has been granted [/p][/*][*][p]Bungie Foundation and Gamers Engaged [/p][/*][*][p]Activities available this week [/p][/*][/list][p]The team is heads down, working towards our June update. We’re aiming for more information to be rolling out by mid-May on what to expect for our next update. As we approach that timeframe, we’ll have a full calendar of sandbox tuning and quality-of-life changes to run through, among other things. Until then, let’s get down to business with a fresh Community Challenge. [/p][p]Read the rest of the TWID [url="https://www.bungie.net/7/en/News/Article/twid_04_23_2026"]here[/url].[/p]
