newsitems.contents:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="DGibdlrwYMg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][u]Declassified, Unleashed: Black Ops Season 03 is Here![/u][/p][p] [/p][h3]The Story So Far[/h3][p] [/p][p]In their next move against The Guild, Karma sends in Cole “Javelin” Donovan. Dropping from international airspace toward a Guild facility over the Arctic Circle, Javelin expertly neutralizes the enemy threats… until Victoria Atwood enters the fray, flanked by her autonomous Rhinos. Little does she know, Javelin has already completed his objective with the help of Karma, hacking into The Guild’s system using the C-Link to take their lethal technology into his own hands.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Season 03 Roadmap[/h3][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a45508a56da7fb8baf215dc8844db8444669f8ad.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]The Season 03 Roadmap showcases another stacked season of content across [i]Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty[/i]®: [i]Warzone[/i]™, with nine new and returning Multiplayer Maps, new Zombies content on day one and a new Round-Based Zombies map at mid-season, a lengthy new Operation across Endgame (now free-to-play for a limited time), a massive new Verdansk Point of Interest in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], six new weapons, and much more![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Season 03 is lifting off. Don’t miss out on this massive update packed with free and premium content arriving when [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i] Season 03 goes live on Thursday, April 2 at 9AM PT.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Endgame Content[/u][/h2][p] [/p][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]FREE TO PLAY: ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Endgame Goes Free to Play:[/b] With Season 03, Endgame goes Free to Play for everyone for a limited time! Invite your squad to join the action, with free players starting as one of the four JSOC Operators from Specter One. Also expect adjustments to Loadouts and loss rules that better fit the evolving dynamics in Endgame Avalon.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Introducing Operations:[/b] Time to go to work. Operations are deploying to Avalon to give your violence a tactical framework, starting with Operation Poison Pill.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Skill Track, Two Abilities: [/b]At launch, summon attack drones and turn enemies into allies with the new Warband Skill Track and hurl a ricocheting projectile with the Aether Blade Ability. Later in the season, unlock the Thermal Spike Ability as a Weekly Challenge reward.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Endgame Goes Free to Play (Launch)[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Calling all Operators! Season 03 marks the beginning of Endgame as a free to play game mode for a limited time, accessible from the main [i]Call of Duty[/i] menu and within [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] and [i]Black Ops 7[/i]. Invite your squad and recruit other players into the action. As a co-operative PvE mode, Endgame is the perfect entry for newcomers and returning [i]Black Ops [/i]veterans alike.[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/566fd8df55e7359c084a45f86d9f1b58843ddad5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[\[BO7-SEASON-03-ANNOUNCEMENT-001]][/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Bringing Avalon to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] through Black Ops Royale, players were introduced a new way to engage with the Black Ops universe. Now, for a limited time, Endgame is also coming to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]![/p][p] [/p][p]For newcomers, Endgame is a co-op PvE experience focused on squad-based runs, boss encounters, and repeatable challenges. Players push through combat spaces together, taking on increasingly difficult encounters across each run. Progression systems like Exotic weapons and Nightmare skills unlock through gameplay and expand your options over time, adding depth as you continue playing.[/p][p] [/p][p]Players can earn XP, complete challenges, and unlock rewards tied to ongoing seasonal updates.[/p][p] [/p][p]For a limited time, the full Endgame experience (not including the Co-Op Campaign) is available directly within [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].[/p][p] [/p][h3]Endgame Season 03 Content Overview[/h3][p]As Season 03 adds further challenges and rewards across Avalon, including the introduction of Operation Poison Pill, now’s the time to grow the ranks and push the attack. Players will continue to progress and earn XP as normal while playing Endgame, tied into the same leveling journey across all four modes.[/p][p] [/p][p]By default, players who do not own [i]Black Ops [/i]7 will begin their Endgame journey with four Operators to choose from: Mason, Anderson, 50/50, and Samuels.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Loadout Updates[/h3][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ae9410916874bdc57128fc8f71ee9b757d3169df.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Starting in Season 03, Endgame Loadouts will be individually assigned to each Operator, so that each separate Endgame Operator has their own Loadout including Weapons, Field Acquisitions, and Equipment. Operators who exfil with a Scorestreak or Self Revive will also save those items for the next deployment. This change provides more customization options, as players can now find and equip a unique Exotic Weapon for every Operator and craft builds that are unique for each fighter.[/p][p] [/p][p]For players who have already experienced Endgame, your existing Loadout will automatically be assigned to your active Operator. All other Operators will start with a default Loadout.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Reset Combat Rating: [/b]Players may optionally reset an Operator's Combat Rating to 0 if they want to start fresh with a new Operator Build. This will not affect the Operator's Loadout, as Weapons, Equipment and rarity are preserved. Note that resetting the Combat Rating will also discard Exotic and Nightmare skills.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Reset Skill Track: [/b]Once you’ve fully progressed an Operator’s Combat Rating by unlocking all Power Upgrades and Skills, you may choose to reset one of your Skill Tracks. Resetting a Skill Track removes all associated Skills and reduces the Operator’s Combat Rating by 16 to reflect the lost power.[/p][p] [/p][p]The next time you increase your Power, you’ll be offered two new Skill Tracks to choose from, giving you greater flexibility to shape an Operator build that better fits your playstyle.[/p][p] [/p][p]Updated Loss Rules[/p][p] [/p][p]As Endgame content becomes more dangerous with Glitches, Guild Strikes, and Nightmare Difficulty zones, the loss rules have been updated to limit how much Combat Rating (CR) players can lose from Skills and Power Upgrades.[/p][p] [/p][p]If a player or squad is wiped, the total Combat Rating lost from earned Skills and Power Upgrades is capped at 15 CR. This means players can lose no more than 15 CR of progression per wipe.[/p][p] [/p][p]Nightmare Skills and Exotic Skills are still fully lost, and the player’s Loadout is reset. Because these Skills contribute to total Combat Rating, their removal will also reduce CR accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Introducing Operation Poison Pill (Launch)[/h3][p] [/p][p]Season 03 ups the ante and introduces Operations into Endgame, kicking things off with Operation Poison Pill. Operations run on a series of strict objectives designed to be cleared across multiple matches. Secure rewards for every objective you complete and systematically power up your Operator for the fight ahead. Clear the final objective to finish the job and unlock direct access to the new Link Forger Glitch Fracture. Operation rewards include a new Weapon Blueprint, Emblem, Double XP Token, Loading Screen, and other rewards, including the new Restore Token consumable item, described below.[/p][p] [/p][p]You’ll want to do your best to keep your Operator in top shape throughout the Operation, especially if you want to remain on track to earn the final rewards (see below), including an animated Weapon Camo.[/p][p] [/p][p]Enter the Link Forger Glitch, Earn Rewards[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/218697d620289363b620b49ec4c694846b3b8762.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Complete Operation steps to earn valuable rewards, power up, and discover the location of the Link Forger Glitch Fracture, in which you and your squad will battle through relentless waves of enemies in a Nightmare Difficulty arena.[/p][p] [/p][p]New for Operation Poison Pill are completion Camos for earning the Glitch Skins. Defeat the Link Forger Glitch Boss with Grimm, Mason, or Anderson to get their unique “Override” Operator Skin.[/p][p] [/p][p]Skin Completion Camos:[/p][p]·        Earn 1 “Override” Skin to get the “Blighted” Weapon Camo.[/p][p]·        Earn all 3 “Override” Skins to get the “Virulent” Animated Weapon Camo.[/p][p] [/p][p]Operation Poison Pill Rewards[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b14d65fb92ee61f58180bf1b3adafc1b2bc5422e.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]·        “Poison Pill” Weapon Charm and 1,000 XP[/p][p]·        Restore Token and 1,000 XP[/p][p]·        1 Hour Double Player XP Token and 1,000 XP[/p][p]·        “Node Husk” Emblem and 2,500 XP[/p][p]·        1 Hour Double Battle Pass XP Token and 2,500 XP[/p][p]·        “Toxic Entry” Large Decal and 2,500 XP[/p][p]·        1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token and 5,000 XP[/p][p]·        “Thorned Muzzle” Loading Screen and 5,000 XP[/p][p]·        “Looking Good!” Emote and 5,000 XP[/p][p]·        “Venomous Override” AAROW 109 Launcher Weapon Blueprint, “Fractal Death” Animated Calling Card, and 7,500 XP[/p][p] [/p][p]Restore Tokens[/p][p]Operator down? With a Restore Token in hand players can choose to activate the consumable item to restore all lost progress, including your Operator’s Skills and current Loadout. The Operation isn’t the only means of earning Restore Tokens; keep an eye out for more chances to acquire this highly valuable item.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]New Warband Skill Track and Abilities[/h3][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4aa6110d3237afd22f20fda3cc2003322b339f00.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Get airborne superiority from attack drones, reinforcements via converted enemies, and other powerful Skills in the new Warband Skill Track, and dispose of enemy forces with the new Aether Blade and Thermal Spike abilities.[/p][p] [/p][p]Skill Track: Warband (Launch)[/p][p][i]Summon powerful allies and turn the tide of battle by amplifying their impact on the battleground.[/i][/p][p][b]Plague: [/b]Eliminated enemies can explode and convert nearby enemies into allies.[/p][p][b]Wirehand: [/b]Eliminations have a chance to spawn an attack drone.[/p][p][b]Smuggler: [/b]Chance to instantly replenish used Equipment and Scorestreaks.[/p][p][b]Bloodrunner: [/b]Gain a damage bonus for rapid multi-kills — ends if momentum stops.[/p][p][b]Healthhounds: [/b]Damage and eliminations from summoned allies restore a portion of health.[/p][p][b]Steelhand (Special Skill): [/b]Picked up armor auto-equips automatically.[/p][p] [/p][p]New Minor Ability: Aether Blade (Launch)[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Aether infused throwing knife that hunts down targets. Hit five with one toss to recover a portion of its charge.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]New Major Ability: Thermal Spike (Mid-Season)[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Emit a powerful blast of flames that incinerate enemies. Flames persist in the area for a short duration.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Multiplayer Content[/u][/h2][p] [/p][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] At launch, experience new maps Beacon and Abyss, drop into the Mission: Trident Skirmish map, and play remasters of Plaza and Gridlock. Keep up the momentum in the Mid-Season with the new Onsen map plus a remastered Summit and the return of Hacienda.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Modes:[/b] Demolition makes its [i]Black Ops 7 [/i]debut at launch, joined shortly afterward by Aim High and Snipers Only. In the Mid-Season, test your parkour skills in the new Freerun mode, turn up the temperature in Heat Wave Havoc, and then chill out with some Freeze Tag.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Additional Loadout Content:[/b] Fry your foes and lockdown areas with the new Ion Core Scorestreak, dealing pulsing radioactive damage in a radius that penetrates walls. Upgrade this devastating weapon with the Plutonium Core or Chemical Catalyst Overclocks.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Black Ops 7 Ranked Play: [/b]Get wins, climb the Ranks, and prove your mettle in the next season of Multiplayer Ranked Play, bringing new rewards to those worthy of the challenge.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Beacon (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/515a988f9d00af65015f56fbb21e8e3eb98352d5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Deploy to the frozen terrain of Beacon, a remote Guild facility blanketed in snow. A destroyed helicopter lies in flaming ruins just outside the map’s border and crates labeled with “Skyveil Array” fill the entrance, offering substantial cover while moving toward the facility.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ad118940a9a9cb49cf3a8f785cded5ba58643612.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Inside, hunt down targets within the Housing unit, Monitoring Station, and Storage shed. Watch out for enemies positioned around the central Bridge and take long shots across the distant Tundra. This mid-sized map combines a variety of sightlines, so there’s no wrong approach. Bundle up, head out, and keep warm with aggressive tactics to overwhelm the enemy forces.[/p][p] [/p][p]Abyss (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f5d5f0d585f984954e0bd2599a724f4dd4870c89.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]From the Engine to the Torpedo Bay, battle through the confined quarters of a submarine, trading shots along narrow corridors with just enough room to outmaneuver your opponents. Keep a keen eye out for rope Ascenders placed throughout the sub, giving access to the Forward and Aft Decks up top to push for the flank... but be mindful of players at the top of the Sail who have views of the upper decks.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3ae3febef7f3ee1fbd47af89b369d9622c375ac7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]In the interior time your movements through tight spaces while seeking out vantage points throughout, such as the upper walkway in the Forward and Aft Silos. When on the same level as your opponent, dodge and weave amongst the boat’s various obstacles to outmaneuver your foe using any means possible.[/p][p] [/p][p]Plaza (Launch)[/p][p][i]Remaster, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p] [/p][p]First introduced in [i]Black Ops 2[/i], Plaza has been beautifully remastered for the first time since 2012. With the addition of Wall Jumping and [i]Black Ops 7[/i]’s unique arsenal, this is Plaza like you’ve never experienced it before.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f42331150f9bcdd46a94173880e93ecbb44d9305.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Battle across the outer Mall and through the Concourse as fireworks burst in the night sky. In the center, engage in fierce fights over the iconic stairwell, rising to an upper platform on both sides, grenades flying as Operators seek to damage enemies on the other side. Explore the luxurious interior locations of the Colossus Resort, including the popular Luna Nightclub alongside high-end shops, the extravagant Red Bar, and other staples of the rich life at sea.[/p][p] [/p][p]Gridlock (Launch)[/p][p][i]Remaster, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2b588ee76e62ebcc966838ca76d797ef4fdf24da.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Traffic grinds to a halt in the remastered Gridlock, first introduced in [i]Black Ops 4[/i]. An explosive heist has left the freeway in shambles over a Japanese city. Battle among overturned vehicles and through the rubble, the remnants of the attack flown across the various shops and Promenade.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/436f6a754097a14261c3f5c349df9c59b756a2c2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Fight through the Garden and Terrace bookending the bath house, or take to the long sightlines down the Street, a delivery truck on either end providing excellent views all around. For a more covered view, head into the Restaurant, offering killer vantage points from multiple angles.[/p][p] [/p][p]Mission: Trident (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New Skirmish Map, 20v20[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2c44674cf48433e1f3acd96f5ef9edc46f87e208.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Season 03 continues to up the map offering in the 20v20 Skirmish mode with Mission: Trident. The Old Arsenal Avalon point of interest is the latest area of operations, with patrol boats assisting in navigating the waterways and shoreline through harbor warehouses and numerous medieval fortifications.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/801170d01da4e1429ea2780cd29699d2d6d9eef3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Seek the helipad on the high ground atop a section of an old cruise liner, with a surprisingly opulent interior. Then watch for rooftop snipers across the long sightlines, ramped bridges, and other thoroughfares.[/p][p] [/p][p]Onsen (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ab3655b6c10457435e2e5c41a0f42ef01cbc3ffa.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Head out to the Japanese hot springs in Onsen, but don’t get too relaxed. This spa offers a number of places to cool down, though the central steam bath is where the action is likely to heat up, especially as it offers the perfect cover for incoming attacks.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/329e8dc6128c3c79ed9294f8dcfe3eb63f943132.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Weave past the oni statue on your way to set up heightened cover positions along the main structure, with outbuildings either side of the steam bath.[/p][p] [/p][p]Summit (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Remastered, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/621631b17bcacb6eab286ff37db839a076a31d8a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Summit makes its triumphant return in [i]Black Ops 7[/i]! First seen in the original [i]Black Ops[/i], this classic mid-sized map brings Operators to a research facility perched high on the snowy mountains. Wall Jump through tight interior labs, catwalks, and a central control room surrounded by exterior routes and a dangerous cliffside.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b0aa97271f632080c01efceaec90115b72d4f294.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Its balanced three-lane layout supports fast engagements, flanking paths, and vertical sightlines, now explorable through the updated [i]Black Ops 7[/i] movement system.[/p][p] [/p][p]Hacienda (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8419995d8517f7cdfe69f9bf0bab4fb2a489d42a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]The luxurious vineyard estate returns from [i]Black Ops 6[/i], now with additional maneuvering points via Wall Jumps. Battle through the grand central villa, weave between vineyard paths, and push through the garage and courtyard as firefights erupt across the property.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/03708a11699d50bb5d0f13fd2fb4320f365a13e2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]With a classic three-lane layout blending tight interior fights and open exterior sightlines, Hacienda delivers fast, tactical engagements in one of the most stylish battlegrounds in the [i]Black Ops[/i] series.[/p][p] [/p][p]Ascent (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]New Special Map, Freerun Mode[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8ffcab81bde807fc2726961c787665ca82c81614.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]This brand-new special map has been created specifically for the Freerun mode. A bespoke obstacle map with vertigo-inducing jumps and little room for error, you’ll need all your dexterity to survive the lengthy ascension to the top of this map![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e4a7029bd57a14b480bda93bab2120017ddb50b1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Test your movement mastery across ten zones within this map, with only your sure footing to help you. Expect more info on this exciting new mode in the Mid-Season update.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p] [/p][p]Demolition (Launch)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ce8eb6b06825cb8b2cb6a93d91a5c1f9f3079cef.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Out with the old, in with the boom. In this explosive returning mode, the attacking team must detonate both bomb sites while the defending team attempts to hold them off, with both sides respawning throughout the match. [/p][p] [/p][p]Each round begins with a two-and-a-half-minute timer and everyone on the attacking team is equipped with a bomb. Plant a bomb at either the A or B site to pause the timer and start the countdown to destruction, giving the defending team an opportunity to sweep in and defuse it. Extra time is added when one site is destroyed, though the attackers must detonate both to win the round.[/p][p] [/p][p]If both teams reach a round tie, then it’s on to Overtime, where both sides fight to be the first to detonate a single site. Push hard and don’t hesitate.[/p][p] [/p][p]Aim High (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode (Moshpit)[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]First introduced in [i]Black Ops 6[/i], Aim High returns, the perfect headshot trainer for sharpshooters of all skill levels. Compete in a variety of game modes where headshots instantly eliminate enemies, while shots against any other part of the body deal minimal damage. Outfit your Loadouts for precision and aim for the noggin.[/p][p] [/p][p]Snipers Only (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode (Moshpit)[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]All warmed up from the Aim High playlist? Turn the challenge up a notch with Snipers Only, a pure sniping experience where Equipment, Secondary Weapons, Field Upgrades, and Scorestreaks are all restricted to keep the focus on the rifle in your hands. Take aim, breathe, and make your shots count.[/p][p] [/p][p]Freerun (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]New Mode[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8647dd945ae87d6f1832794653b4b427de18aa2d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Run and climb your way through Ascent, an original map for the new Freerun mode arriving in the Mid-Season that pits ten racers in a sprint to the finish line. Compete for additional rewards in the Mid-Season Freerun Event.[/p][p] [/p][p]Heat Wave Havoc (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]New Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]Bring the burn in the new Heat Wave Havoc LTM, challenging players to raise their Heat Level by supporting the team with non-lethal cooperative actions in a Moshpit of Team Deathmatch, Kill Confirmed, Domination, and Hardpoint.[/p][p] [/p][p]There are five Heat Levels in all, with each level granting additional abilities that will transform your Operator into a blazing ball of fury. Generate heat through support actions like revealing enemies, scrambling enemy radars, buffing teammates and impairing enemies, capturing and defending objectives, and other non-lethal actions.[/p][p] [/p][p]The Heat Levels and their corresponding Operator bonuses are as follows:[/p][p] [/p][p]·        [b]Low Heat:[/b] Faster Field Upgrade recharge.[/p][p]·        [b]Medium Heat:[/b] Faster movement, sprint-to-fire speed, and mid-air mobility.[/p][p]·        [b]Hot:[/b] Faster weapon reloads, ADS speed, and swap speed.[/p][p]·        [b]Extra Hot:[/b] Equipment refills after eliminating enemies.[/p][p]·        [b]Extra Extra Hot:[/b] Increased damage and score for headshots.[/p][p] [/p][p]Freeze Tag (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]New Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]Following the scorching Heat Wave Havoc, take some time to chill in the new Freeze Tag LTM. When dealt lethal damage, Operators will now become frozen instead of being eliminated. Freezing rival players will earn score for your team. Fellow teammates can save their incapacitated allies by reaching and defending their frozen forms, helping to unthaw them in time to rejoin the fight. The first team to reach the score limit wins.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Additional Loadout Content[/h3][p] [/p][p]Area denied. Fight to increase your Skill Rating, earn exclusive rewards, and climb the Skill Divisions on your way to the top.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b] [/b][/p][p] [/p][h3]New Verdansk Point of Interest: Launch Pad (Launch)[/h3][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/18bb3f2483f7e3185a69118bdf2d40953be2a692.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]All systems are a go as the new Launch Pad POI arrives in Verdansk as the original big map returns at the start of Season 03! The Launch Pad is a massive complex with multiple structures found near the shoreline just south of Promenade. The Grazna-7 Launch Complex takes over the old Hills POI with a sprawling facility comprised primarily of the Control Tower, Hangar, Gantry, and the Depot and Vats.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c4d885380afb730b1de3169f1c3bbfd9ed9ba99c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Perch atop the large structures here to snipe distant enemies or get lost in the infrastructure, weaving between the area’s many obstacles to set up ambushes and flank attacks. In a facility this large, you can be sure there’s plenty of loot to be had with intense firefights all around. Now let’s take a closer look at the Launch Pad’s various elements:[/p][p] [/p][p]Control Tower[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e04e37dc85c0323b08bb3c163fd9c139593b1d1b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Though technically the smallest of the three major structures across Launch Pad — including the Control Tower, Hangar, and Gantry — the Control Tower is still a beast, providing views over a wide swath of the map’s southwestern boundary. For a quick lay of the land, latch onto the exterior Ascender to zip[/p][p]up to the rooftop, the base of the satellite offering the highest vantage point. Near the Ascender, you’ll also find a ladder giving access to a viewing balcony with a Zipline leading to the Hangar.[/p][p] [/p][p]Inside, step into the lobby and enjoy the displays on your way toward the administrative offices, server room, and control room. Move through the different levels using the staircases and the elevator shaft Ascenders, battling in close quarters inside while checking the exterior views for enemies incoming from a distance.[/p][p] [/p][p]Hangar[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9152669c2ecd8171d37f641aab69347305d159b7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]The tallest building in Launch Pad, its height matched only by the nearby Gantry, Hangar brings verticality to a whole new level. Inside, a large winding staircase gives access to multiple platforms, including a raised central platform with views inside and out toward the Gantry. In some modes, a massive rocket stands in the middle, while in others the Hangar is empty inside.[/p][p] [/p][p]Keep climbing to access the upper exterior walkway, also accessible via the exterior ladder on the building’s south side. From the walkway, you can Zipline to the Control Tower or Hangar or take the Ascender up to the rooftop for unmatched views of the surrounding area.[/p][p] [/p][p]Gantry[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/92033cf275354b24d9814c2bdb6a79dca9836f50.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Across from the Hangar and connected via Zipline, Gantry offers another major vantage point up and down its exterior elements. Climb one of its twin staircases up to the mid-point walkway for views closer the ground or ascend to the top to snipe at foes from way up high. Though the Gantry offers little interior room, there are plenty of places for an Operator to hide and make a stand, so keep your eyes on those corners. When you need a quick escape from the Launch Pad, this is an ideal launching point into the surrounding areas of the map.[/p][p] [/p][p]For those who prefer fighting on the ground floor, look for a line that descends below the central flame trench or fight within it, moving through the blast doors on either side.[/p][p] [/p][p]Depot and Vats[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0f6ad66272c2f25066401f42aa2b0a56af6b0687.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Watch for the train pulling into the Depot on the south end of Launch Pad between the Gantry and Hangar. Though the station is small compared to its monstrous neighbors, the area contains plenty of little perches and vantage points that can be used to attack enemies moving between the larger structures.[/p][p] [/p][p]Follow the road or train track to the fuel tanks and vats lining the east end of Launch Pad. Climb on top for a low view over the road and toward the Hangar and Control Tower. It’s also possible to traverse the platform topping the fuel lines here, using it as a walkway to cover the road. Open Guild crates and some single-story office buildings provide further points of contact; fall back to these when spotted to disorient the enemy and ambush them when they come searching for you.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]The Gulag Arrives in Avalon (In-Season)[/h3][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cc08eb9f87294e062f9820a56574711513c8a396.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]The Core Battle Royale experience is about to get a whole lot bigger as Operators begin dropping into Avalon for the first time in-season! In preparation for the map’s debut into Battle Royale, recent discoveries indicate The Guild has been hard at work developing not one but three Gulags where fallen Operators will get the chance to fight for their redeployment into the map.[/p][p] [/p][p]Note that Wall Jumping is disabled in the Gulags. You have to earn your way out.[/p][p] [/p][p]Similar to the three Gulag Verdansk variants, each Gulag is a compact, roughly octagon-shaped combat arena with a central area of high traffic, and interrogation stations around an upper floor where Operators waiting to fight can observe the action. Inside these arenas, expect automatic doors you can use as dynamic cover, reinforced glass windows allowing you to see — but not initially harm — your opponent, and other tactical novelties.[/p][p] [/p][p]Gulag Variant #1: Server Room 04[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bc3aa15159b1c7c18999686650bf0c64b7c5ec71.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i][b] [/b][/i][/p][p]Banks of servers surround a main server chamber, with sliding doors along all four inner walls.[/p][p] [/p][p]Gulag Variant #2: Cryo Lab 05[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1d7d5372a847fc5fadc42db32d905d2ed8791c78.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Banks of cryo coffins and diagonal entrances mark the A and B areas of this cooled chamber.[/p][p] [/p][p]Gulag Variant #3: Meeting Room 07[/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eb38f764099d06759c8436ffc62d53cccbe26674.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Advance into a central meeting room with open doorways and low central seating in a circular bench.[/p][p] [/p][h3]New Modes and Updates (Launch, In-Season)[/h3][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/325e57dc9c7e40929752d1c0b16f60a5b938d3e4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Core Battle Royale experience is planned to host a big map rotation between Verdansk and Avalon, giving squads the chance to drop into either map for double the tactical thrills. Get after it.[/p][p] [/p][p]Hot Pursuit (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Avalon, Black Ops Royale[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/deae109c3609f7f5287293d327b84eafcf423606.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Get ready for a high-speed chase in this LTM coming to Black Ops Royale, inspired by the original Blackout mode! Whether you're hopping into a police vehicle to track down the robbers or jumping in a getaway car to find valuables, two constants hold true for everyone: Vehicular combat is key to success, and survival is all that matters.[/p][p] [/p][p]Prop Hunt Royale (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Rebirth Island, 48 players[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b354e078162d16a5f418a33e1d5e4d64a15263b9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]The enemy could be anywhere… or anything. Luckily, you’ll have the whole squad at your back with 24v24 Prop Hunt on Rebirth Island.[/p][p] [/p][p]In this round-based mode, teams alternate between Hunters and Props. The Props win if at least one teammate survives until the end of the round, while the Hunters win if all Props are eliminated. The first team to win three rounds wins the match![/p][p] [/p][p]Returning LTM: Iron Gauntlet \[Beta] (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Avalon, 150 Players[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1c1c62d9ce7ae9281f2efcfd43e655a7151085a8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2e1e5c6c8dfdfb1a0bcc86e95961619fd17e3ecd.png"][/img][/p][p]The Iron Gauntlet arrives in Avalon! Drop into a competitive Battle Royale tournament as a Trio with adjusted rules that favor skill over luck, including scarce resources, rapid circle collapses, increased base health for every Operator, loot rebalancing, one hit kill protection, and other changes keeping the action focused on decision making and gunplay.
[/p][p]We've listened to player feedback, and Iron Gauntlet has undergone some major revisions, we've moved the mode to Avalon, updated it from Duos to Trios, adjusted the economy, iterated on TTK, and added a variety of other adjustments.[/p][p] [/p][p]Expect rewards to earn by proving your mettle in the Iron Gauntlet, and the format of the ladder mirrors Ranked Play Resurgence, but with Iron Gauntlet-specific balance and scoring considerations.[/p][p] [/p][p]Season 03 Iron Gauntlet Rewards[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f5edd2de48dbfd9585757a10beb78c9805479894.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]·        [b]Get 5 Iron Gauntlet Wins:[/b] “WZ Iron Gauntlet 03” Weapon Charm and Weapon Vinyl[/p][p]·        [b]Get Any Placement in Iron Gauntlet leaderboard.:[/b] “WZ Iron Gauntlet Placement” Emblem[/p][p]·        [b]Get Top 25 on the Iron Gauntlet leaderboard:[/b] “WZ Iron Gauntlet Top 25” Weapon Camo and Emblem[/p][p]·        [b]Get Top 10 on theIron Gauntlet Leaderboard:[/b] “WZ Iron Gauntlet Top 10” Emblem[/p][p]·        [b]Get Top 5 on the Iron Gauntlet Leaderboard:[/b] “WZ Iron Gauntlet Top 5” Animated Weapon Camo and Emblem[/p][p]·        [b]Get First Place on the Iron Gauntlet Leaderboard:[/b] “WZ Iron Gauntlet #1” Animated Emblem[/p][p] [/p][h3]New Gameplay Features (Launch, Mid-Season)[/h3][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/12c320cf9b60dc6b7c9b2622ea1b05e3c00cc7e9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Season 03 brings major updates to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], including the introduction of Wall Jumps and the Grappling Hook into Battle Royale, the new Flashpoint Public Event, a new way to power up your Operator with the addition of Spikes, and the Cluster Grenade.[/p][p] [/p][p]Private Match: New Features and Functionality (Launch)[/p][p] [/p][p]Whether you’re organizing a tournament or bringing in squads for a clandestine lobby, expect a host of new adjustments and improvements within the Private Match mode:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Code Functionality: [/b]Private Match codes are now hidden by default when the Lobby is created and can be toggled to be visible or not.[/p][p][b]            Match Lobby Disbanding:[/b] Lobbies no longer disband after a match completes. If your squad has won, the squad leader receives a “return to lobby” option. If your squad has lost, you can spectate or leave the lobby or party. Players must wait for the rest of their party to finish the match before everyone can be taken back to the Lobby.[/p][p][b]Squad Name Changes: [/b]Members of a Squad can change the name of the squad they belong to. One squad member has this edit function.[/p][p][b]Gamertag Obscuring: [/b]The Host now supports the option to obscure player names/gamer tags in the Lobby. When set, a random pool of anonymized player names/gamer tags is used to substitute in for action names in the kill feed, scoreboard, et al. This is a full Lobby setting and cannot be changed by individual players.[/p][p][b]Scoreboard Updates:[/b] Expect additional features within the end-of-match scoreboard, including a per-squad and per-player breakdown, and sorting by different values (such as XP earned, eliminations, score, etc).[/p][p] [/p][p]Wall Jump, Grappling Hook (Launch)[/p][p]Get ready to jump, dive, and grapple your way across [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Wall-jumping and the Grappling Hook will be available for use in Battle Royale and Resurgence matches at the start of the season, including Verdansk![/p][p] [/p][p]Flashpoint Public In-Match Event (Launch)[/p][p]Ignite the match with an explosive strike from Verdansk’s new Launch Pad in the all-new Flashpoint Public Event. When this event occurs, a random location is designated as the target, initiating a countdown until the chosen location is bombarded by a missile strike, eliminating all players in the area and leaving a damaging cloud in its wake that covers the immediate area until eventually dissipating.[/p][p] [/p][p]Then, as Season 03 progresses, ensure you’re checking the environment in preparation for hunting down some particularly potent classified weaponry….[/p][p] [/p][p]New Equipment: Introducing Spikes (Mid-Season)[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ff41ae4a41068915a70ecbd6c06ae2589101a0b3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Become even more powerful with the addition of Spikes, experimental military stimulants that enhance your Operator, coming to a Buy Station near you in Season 03. Choose tactically; should you fall, you’ll need to buy your Spikes back again.[/p][p]·        [b]Armor Salvaging: [/b]Immediately gain an equipped Armor Plate after eliminating an enemy.[/p][p]·        [b]Prone Firing: [/b]Greatly reduce weapon recoil while crouched or prone.[/p][p]·        [b]Handicraft: [/b]Regenerate Equipment over time.[/p][p] [/p][p]Lethals Arrive in New Game Modes[/p][p] [/p][p][b]EMP Grenade (Launch): [/b]Disrupt your enemy communications and equipment by lobbing an EMP Grenade at your foes, available across Core Battle Royale and Resurgence modes at Season 03 Launch.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Cluster Grenade (Mid-Season):[/b] Currently available as ground loot in Black Ops Royale — will be available across Core Battle Royale and Resurgence modes across [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]! Toss one and watch your enemies scatter to avoid the series of explosions that follow.[/p][h3][/h3]

newsitems.title: Introducing the Season 03 Battle Pass, BlackCell, and New Store Bundles
newsitems.author: ATVI_Dov
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/09634b6706431fc1837f79b80f63800846aa620e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Raise the Stakes with the Season 03 Battle Pass![/h2][p]JSOC enlists Cole “Javelin” Donovan to infiltrate The Guild, sending the aerial tactician to a frozen facility in the Arctic Circle with instructions to hack into the company’s systems, wreaking havoc. Press the advantage with help from a brand-new Battle Pass, new BlackCell content, and Store Bundles arriving when Season 03 of [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i] launches at 9AM PT on April 2.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dfd9a91dac7a9f76050d780acec8725500c4b6d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Access 100+ rewards including new free base weapons plus new Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Finishing Moves and more found throughout the Season 03 Battle Pass. Purchase the premium Battle Pass for 1,100 COD Points to unlock progress through all Battle Pass rewards or grab the Battle Pass Bundle for 2,400 COD Points, including 20+ Tier Skips to get a jump on the journey ahead.[/p][p] [/p][p]Get BlackCell for the ultimate seasonal experience, including unique Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, and more.[/p][p][/p][h2]BlackCell Season 03: Valkyrie Operator (JSOC)[/h2][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a2af60d84c505d2a60fd4ece1f8fadb19ea06477.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Outfitted with a next-generation mobility rig and neural-linked targeting suite, Valkyrie was designed for warfare in dense battlespaces. Developed through the CIA’s experimental augmentation programs, she represents a new type of combat asset — part soldier, part weapons platform.[/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4267f75f07ca7684312d599f402805120c17cf9f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]BlackCell users can deploy as the winged Operator at the start of the season, joined by her two sister warriors “Scarlett” and “Ash,” represented by two additional Operator Skins for Valkyrie unlockable via in-game challenges.[/p][p] [/p][p]The winged Operators are joined by a cast of fierce Operator Skins and Weapon Blueprints earned through BlackCell.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Additional BlackCell Instant Rewards Content[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Get the full Battle Pass experience with BlackCell, providing access to every reward available throughout the Season 03 Battle Pass. Your purchase grants immediate access to the BlackCell Instant Rewards Page, delivering the following items:[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b82caec6d1600f0512b91fe6f1156815c0f31329.jpg"][/img][/p][p]· “Valkyrie” BlackCell Operator Skin plus the “Scarlett” and “Ash” alternate Skins earnable through Challenges.[/p][p]· 1,100 COD Points[/p][p]· “Tribulation” Mastercraft Blueprint for the Razor 9MM SMG (Tracers, Death FX) plus the “Voltrix” and “Malison” alternate Blueprints earnable through Challenges.[/p][p]· “Say ‘Hello’” Finishing Move[/p][p]· “Drone Caller” Emote[/p][p]· The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and Winner’s Circles)[/p][p]· “BlackCell No.3” HUD Theme[/p][p]· 10% XP Loyalty Boost[/p][p] [/p][p]BlackCell owners can earn even more rewards throughout the Season 03 Battle Pass, unlocking bonus content across multiple Pages, featuring:[/p][p] [/p][p]· Seven BlackCell-exclusive Skins, including:[/p][p]o   The “Grasp” BlackCell Skin for the new Javelin Operator[/p][p]o   The “Riven” BlackCell Skin for Javelin[/p][p]o   The “Lockdown” BlackCell Skin for T.E.D.D.[/p][p]o   The “Serrated” BlackCell Skin for Wei Lin[/p][p]o   The “Icecap” BlackCell Skin for Dempsey[/p][p]o   The “Sleepless” BlackCell Skin for Richtofen[/p][p]o   The “Tacit” BlackCell Skin for Karma[/p][p][/p][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/72ff6f49461d61a6a89c385905e5c71aa889f360.jpg"][/img][/p][p]· Seven BlackCell-exclusive Weapon Blueprints:[/p][p]o   The “Flameout” BlackCell Blueprint for the M34 Novaline Marksman Rifle[/p][p]o   The “Bulkhead” BlackCell Blueprint for the Hawker HX Sniper Rifle[/p][p]o   The “Legend” BlackCell Blueprint for the MK.78 LMG[/p][p]o   The “Poseidon’s Wrath” BlackCell Blueprint for the Ryden 45K SMG[/p][p]o   The “Saku” BlackCell Blueprint for the MK35 ISR Assault Rifle[/p][p]o   The “Ursine” BlackCell Mastercraft Blueprint for the X9 Maverick Assault Rifle[/p][p]o   The “Icebane” BlackCell Reactive Blueprint for the VST SMG[/p][p] [/p][p]Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]BlackCell Weapon Camo Track: [/b]This season, BlackCell introduces the all-new BlackCell Camo track, offering additional universal Camo rewards for BlackCell owners who display their skill across five different Weapon Classes.[/p][p] [/p][p]Take on Challenges with Assault Rifles, SMGs, Sniper Rifles, Pistols, and Special Weapons. Complete Challenges in any of the four major game modes to earn a new BlackCell Weapon Camo, including an Animated Mastery Camo awarded for displaying exceptional combat prowess.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]BlackCell Bonus: Extra Daily Challenges: [/b]As with previous seasons, BlackCell users will receive an additional Daily Challenge throughout Season 03 for Endgame, Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].[/p][p] [/p][p][b]BlackCell Loyalty Bonus: [/b]Players who purchased Season 02 BlackCell and go on to purchase Season 03 BlackCell will activate a permanent 10% Player and Weapon XP bonus in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] (up to a 50% bonus for purchasing BlackCell in every [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i] season).[/p][p][/p][h2]Purchase the Battle Pass: Instantly Unlock the Javelin Operator[/h2][h2]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/13970237b23321a64c7eb6860a646ed53bb6d048.jpg"][/img][/h2][p]Players who purchase the premium Season 03 Battle Pass or BlackCell gain full access to the Battle Pass Instant Rewards Page, unlocking the following items:[/p][p]· 10% Battle Pass XP Boost[/p][p]· The “Grasp” Operator Skin for the new Javelin Operator plus a BlackCell variant for those who purchase BlackCell[/p][p]· The “Tally” Legendary Blueprint for the AK-27 Assault Rifle[/p][p]· The “High Altitude” Weapon Charm[/p][p]· The “Corvo” Large Decal[/p][p] [/p][p]The Season 03 Battle Pass features 100+ pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell) including two new (and free) Base Weapons, a new Free Attachment, and more. Focus on the following Pages to obtain these weapons:[/p][list][*][p][b]Free Weapon Unlock: [/b]MK35 ISR Assault Rifle[/p][/*][*][p][b]Free Weapon Unlock: [/b]VST SMG[/p][/*][*][p][b]Free Attachment Unlock: [/b]VAS Convergent Foregrip[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]New Operator: Javelin (JSOC)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c10a2f8676fe1bf5a466ad21766b8d7eb78d8737.jpg"][/img][i]“Karma, I’m in.” [/i]— Cole “Javelin” Donovan[/p][p][/p][p]Donovan is a veteran HALO diver specializing in high-risk solo insertions into heavily contested territory. Trained in infiltration, reconnaissance, and close-quarters combat, he executes missions with minimal support and no margin for error. Long deployments in black operations have left him blunt, self-reliant, and willing to bend the rules if the objective demands it. Despite that reputation, Donovan never hesitates to take the jump when others won’t, making him one of JSOC’s most valued Operators.[/p][p][/p][h2]Additional Battle Pass Operator Skins[/h2][p] [/p][p]Progress through the Battle Pass to unlock multiple Operator Skins, many paired with BlackCell variants, including the following:[/p][p][/p][h3]T.E.D.D.: “Lockdown” Skins[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ed4085afd97f02e4c7ea778e46a11dda2f5fef23.jpg"][/img]T.E.D.D. deploys as Guild private security with a baseball cap, ear protection, and body armor over a brown jumpsuit. In the BlackCell variant, T.E.D.D. sheds any attempt at blending in, favoring a metal frame from top to bottom, his face barely recognizable as “human.”[/p][p] [/p][h3]Samuels: “Subnaut” Skin[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1fa611ef12ce9d8c76ab812a71145b0365beaf4a.jpg"][/img]Samuels suits up for amphibious warfare in the “Subnaut” Operator Skin, donning a Mil-Sim uniform with a breathing apparatus, breaching tools, and a water-resistant camouflaged uniform.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Wei Lin: “Serrated” Skins[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/855dc943101f35664b825a0484ec2057417e6356.jpg"][/img]Even the frigid facility in the new Beacon Multiplayer map won’t stop Wei Lin, outfitted here with heavy armor suited for cold weather operations in hostile environments. In the BlackCell variant, she dons war paint and armor plates over insulated black fabric.[/p][p][/p][h3]Dempsey: “Icecap” Skins[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6420b14004bd1fda193cdf340fc09f92d9df31e8.jpg"][/img]No matter the obstacle, human or environmental, Dempsey is ready to handle it, equipped with blue snow gear, shades, gloves, and tools to keep up the fight in unforgiving weather. The BlackCell variant favors a more sinister look, equally prepared for difficult terrain in a sleek gold and black design.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Jurado: “Summit” Skin[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/068c90e2c6a50770d6eb3c8bb7bda59a9b9ff910.jpg"][/img]When Summit returns in the Mid-Season, this is your man to get the job done. Deploy in a Mil-Sim uniform designed for operations in the snow. Combining combat and medical gear, insulation, and armored protection from head to toe, Jurado is ready for anything.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Anderson: “Bail Out” Skin[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a0129cf3e2fcf99c719b1d5a021a356c2dd207c3.jpg"][/img] Take command of the high seas with this nautical themed Operator Skin featuring a black tactical vest over blue camouflage. When infiltrating the harbor in the new Mission: Trident Skirmish map, deploy as Anderson to get the job done.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Richtofen: “Sleepless” Skins[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a18d460611c2d7314dfd6a8d0e73ed114706dc51.jpg"][/img]Richtofen pursues his enemies to the ends of the earth as an anonymous assassin, geared to the teeth with bandoliers and a mesh veil concealing his identity. The BlackCell variant opts for heavy armor, combining modern tactical wear with chain mail and a metal mask.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Karma: “Tacit” Skins[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/79ac5da80aac72a9331a118d1b27c9e14a9dc95a.jpg"][/img]Hit the streets in tactical urban wear as Karma sports a mohawk, combining a tank top, leather jacket, and jeans to blend in with crowds and for maximum mobility in fights. The expert hacker applies war paint and armor in the BlackCell variant, for those seeking a more aggressive look.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Grimm: “Windburn” Skin[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/67087d3671bb001f41f1beb0a596c8f746eda707.jpg"][/img]Excel in all drop zones wielding the latest tech in aerial deployments. An oxygen tank provides air for the Operator, connected to the impact resistant helmet. Light, wind resistant armor provides protection in the air and the on the ground, supported by digital readouts for intel gathering.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Season 03: Battle Pass: Free Base Weapons, Attachment[/h2][p][/p][p]Zero in on targets with the low recoil MK35 ISR Assault Rifle and outmaneuver foes with the lightweight VST SMG. Unlock these two new free Base Weapons and the new VAS Convergence Foregrip Attachment in the Season 03 Battle Pass.[/p][p] [/p][p]All players can unlock these weapons for free by progressing through their listed Battle Pass Pages.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Primary Weapon: MK35 ISR[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e075a338aee33a04a05fd4684eff87a2bd75523c.jpg"][/img][b]Levels: 43[/b][/p][p][b]MAGS: 3[/b][/p][p][b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b][/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Blueprints, Camos and Reticle Unlocks (CM, MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Full-auto assault rifle. Low recoil for excellent accuracy with moderate damage and handling.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]The MK35 ISR combines exceptionally clear iron sights with a fast fire rate and controllable recoil even through sustained fire. The base model’s excellent performance only grows with Gunsmith configuration, including the Integrated Suppressor Prestige Attachment transforming the weapon into an incredibly powerful stealth asset.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Prestige Attachment — Integrated Suppressor: [/b]Integrated suppressor barrel removes firing signature from mini-map and improves damage range and hipfire spread.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Primary Weapon: VST[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2ac51cfdeab842b7d80d84eded52ed66bf769364.jpg"][/img][b]Levels: 39[/b][/p][p][b]MAGS: 4[/b][/p][p][b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b][/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Blueprints, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (CM, MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Full-auto submachine gun. Lightweight for excellent mobility with good handling. Supports multiple calibers.[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Get up close and tear them to shreds with this lightweight eliminator, a hipfire machine that supports high mobility, close range play. Recoil can be somewhat mitigated through burst fire and Attachments improving weapon control. For a beefier model, equip the Ammo Conversion Prestige Attachment providing a higher damage output and range allowing you to remain competitive at further ranges.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Prestige Attachment — Ammo Conversion: [/b]Converts weapon to use 5.56x30mm ammo for improved damage and range with more controllable recoil. Harms fire rate, mobility, and handling. Gives access to new Magazine Attachments including:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]5.56m Extended Mag I: [/b]Extended magazine provides improved ammo capacity with a small handling trade off.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]5.56m Fast Mag I: [/b]Significantly improves reload and handling speeds at the cost of ammo capacity.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]5.56m Extended Mag II: [/b]Extended magazine provides additional ammo with a stronger handling trade off.[/p][p][/p][h3]Attachment: VAS Convergence Foregrip[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5c18b35d82c86a0990d7c54541cd23ca4160e86d.jpg"][/img][i]Underbarrel foregrip to improve bullet deviation and recoil stabilization for a smoother and more predictable recoil pattern.[/i][/p][p] [/p][h2]Season 03 Weapon Blueprints[/h2][p] [/p][p]Unlock over 20 Weapon Blueprints spread throughout the Season 03 Battle Pass and BlackCell, including the following Blueprints as they appear throughout the Battle Pass Pages. Blueprints marked with an “*” indicate they have a BlackCell variant, shown after this section.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Prestige Unlocks: [/b]As with previous seasons, any weapon you earn in the Battle Pass becomes accessible to you throughout your Prestige journey all the way to Master Prestige. This allows you to spend Prestige Unlock Tokens on other items when acquired.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Battle Pass Weapon Blueprints[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/587bff130bde733ed20a589c548ea0935ce7a8ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p](Above) “Tally” AK-27 Assault Rifle, Battle Pass Instant Reward[/p][p]“Flameout” M34 Novaline Marksman Rifle, HVT[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0edfa40cf66f8144dfe814eab2d344087ef4db87.jpg"][/img][/p][p](Above) “Dark Air” Kogot-7 SMG,[/p][p]“Surface Tension” Ballistic Knife Melee[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/91fe653ea484b6548610e7e944e8506e661489e8.jpg"][/img][/p][p](Above) “Bulkhead” Hawker HX Bulkhead, HVT, [/p][p]“Tropic” Peacekeeper MK1 Assault Rifle[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4533a6437ec85f1dad3a1149635a2f2ca21efe5e.jpg"][/img][/p][p] (Above) “Imminent Peril” M15 MOD 0 Assault Rifle,[/p][p]“Bowline” NX Ravager Special[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1729b4a9d88444b184d2b669e5f151edcabbfc9c.jpg"][/img] [/p][p](Above) “The Myth” Warden 308 Marksman Rifle, [/p][p]“The Legend” MK.78 LMG, HVT[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/210d73daa18abeb1306510cc74c4820e5d8cbe8b.jpg"][/img] [/p][p](Above) “Permafrost” Akita Shotgun, [/p][p]“Piranha” Velox 5.7 Pistol[/p][p]
